name: Loading / saving data in Unity
goal: For saving (especially big amounts of) game data, JSON serializers are commonly used. A scriptable object is most useful for this.

normalLearnings: I can save data to a persistent path.
I can load data from a persistent path.
result: As seen in <<video Saving Loading Data.mp4>> data can be modified, saved and loaded.
validation: In a peer review, the work has been approved.
contribution: Now that I have an understanding on how to save and load data, I will implement it in the duo game itself.
